title: Choose the one-screen landing · dark, dramatic
question: Re-rolled again: dark, much less text, one dramatic moment. Headline, one visual, the demo button, and a single line for how it works and who it's for.

options.label: The wipe
options.lineage: paper vs evidence, as one moment
options.thesis: One line, two worlds. The letter's claim set huge in highlighter on dark paper; a glowing orange edge has wiped across, and on the blueprint side the same claim carries a giant 9 of 12 stamp. A five-word headline, the button, and one thin line for how it works and who it's for.
options.viewport: Headline 'Paper says done. Proof shows it.' at 92px top left. Across the middle: "Windows complete: 12" at 64px in highlighter on the paper side; the orange edge; a 120px 9 of 12 stamp on the blueprint side. Button below. Foot: READ → PLACE → COUNT → JUDGE · for builders, buyers and banks. Signature: on load the edge sweeps left to right and the stamp presses as it passes. Phone: claim, edge sweeping down, stamp, button.
options.risk: One claim carries the story; the evidence frame itself waits for the demo.

raised.raise: The wipe moves like ink across the sheet, once, then holds.
Few tones, total commitment: two grounds, one highlighter, one signal orange.

options.label: The tally wall
options.lineage: the report's tally, at wall scale
options.thesis: The answer as architecture: 9 of 12 at 170px, and under it the twelve-cell tally as a wall filling the screen: nine lit green, two rust, one dashed ghost for Not seen yet.
options.viewport: 9 of 12 at 170px top left; the claim, one line and the button top right; twelve full-height cells across the width with three short labels under them. Foot line as the others. Signature: cells light one by one on load. Phone: the number, a 4×3 grid of cells, button.
options.risk: Abstract: a judge sees a result before they see what produced it.

options.label: One window, huge
options.thesis: One window filling the right of a dark frame, outlined in glowing orange, stamped Counted once. The proof at the scale of the thing proved: a headline, the BOQ line and the button on the left.
options.viewport: Left: 'Every window, seen and counted.' at 104px, the quoted BOQ line, the button. Right: a dark room with one huge window outlined in orange and a Counted once stamp; a mono mock-frame caption. Foot line. Signature: the outline draws itself round the window on load. Phone: frame first, headline, button.
options.risk: The frame is a drawn mock until real footage exists; it must say so on the page.
